invariants.name: a completed PM cannot be re-completed
invariants.oracle: a completed PM cannot be re-completed - terminal state frozen, proven by attempting the transition and reading the refusal

invariants.name: one completion writes one row + one mirror
invariants.oracle: completing a PM writes exactly one pm_completions row and exactly one logbook mirror - not zero, not two (trigger_fires_once)

invariants.name: tile and view agree after a completion
invariants.oracle: compliance % recomputes from completions; the tile and the view never disagree after a completion, including across the cron sweep

invariants.name: a scope item cannot be ticked out of scope
invariants.oracle: a scope item cannot be ticked for an asset outside the PM's own scope

invariants.name: overdue derives from the schedule's due date
invariants.oracle: overdue is computed from the schedule's own due date, not from now() - created_at

invariants.name: pm_* isolation end to end
invariants.oracle: a foreign hive's PM rows are invisible through the views, the reads and the realtime channel

domain_truths.oracle: SMRP PM compliance comes from get_pm_compliance_smrp - the SAME number Analytics shows - and the label names the denominator; the metric's-label-is-a-claim class

domain_truths.name: on-time names its tolerance window
domain_truths.oracle: on-time is defined against a stated tolerance window, and the window is on screen

domain_truths.name: deferred is not completed
domain_truths.oracle: a PM deferred is not a PM completed, and the surface distinguishes them

domain_truths.name: calendar vs runtime frequency is stated
domain_truths.oracle: PM frequency (calendar vs runtime-based) is stated per task; a runtime PM on a calendar without its hours is misleading

domain_truths.name: the compliance window is named beside the %
domain_truths.oracle: the compliance window (90 days, per the RPC call the page actually makes) is named wherever the % appears

domain_truths.name: a completion records who, from the JWT
domain_truths.oracle: a completion records who performed it, from the JWT, never from a typed name

domain_truths.name: skipped/NA scope items exit the denominator visibly
domain_truths.oracle: skipped/NA scope items are recorded with a reason and excluded from the denominator explicitly - vacuity recorded, not counted

domain_truths.name: a PM-missed breakdown traces back
domain_truths.oracle: PM-driven findings that become breakdowns are traceable back to the PM that missed them
